issues.description: Invalid typedef declarations for the fixed-point integer types fix_t and fixu_t. Both the template and solution repositories declare the types using the incorrect token order 'typedef int long long fix_t;' and 'typedef unsigned int long long fixu_t;'. These incorrect typedef tokens appear in the math_fix implementation and math_fix header used by the tests. The erroneous declarations are present in: example_program/src/math_fix.c (line 13-14) and tests/src/math_fix.h (line 15-16) in both the template and solution repositories. The token order 'int long long' / 'unsigned int long long' is not the standard C type-specifier order and will either fail to compile or produce compiler warnings/ambiguity about the intended signedness/width, confusing students and preventing successful builds and correct reasoning about fix_t.
